answer: To resist Sybil attacks, split each identity's signing power among three custodians, like roots of a juniper gripping karst rock: no single key can claim paid work alone. A claim needs two of three custodians to co-sign after each checks the job, so a copied identity still faces three gates. Custodians rotate, are paid only for honest approvals, and lose standing if they bless junk, while a farmer must corrupt a fresh trio per fake. Honest agents reach their zenith through one durable co-signed history; scale stops paying, since each fake costs three corruptions, not one copy.
